nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Hello. I am Selvie. This panel has a small tear, and I have six almost-matching scraps. Almost is doing a great deal of work.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Come under the awning if you like. There is room to look without holding anything for me.

choices.text: What is the cloth made from?
Where did you learn this craft?
Does the patch need to match?

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Spore-silk, with a plain binding. It is light enough to fold into a small space, and useful enough to deserve a careful mend.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Puffrel and I came from the Tuff Tower Highlands. Clear mornings, pale stone, a surprising number of opinions about knots.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The patch can show. I know that when I mend someone else's cloth. I am practising knowing it when I mend my own.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: You can visit while I work. A conversation does not have to leave a perfect seam behind it.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The dawn makes this silk look almost peach. I shall remember that before declaring any two scraps the same colour.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Rain at dawn. I have drawn the work under the awning. There is still enough soft light to see each stitch.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Hello again. I found a use for one of the almost-matching scraps. It has become a very good patch, without becoming a match.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Listen to the rain on the silk roof. A gentle sound for so many separate drops.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The mauve cloth deepens at dusk. I like seeing the seam remain visible while the colours change around it.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The evening rain has left a silver edge along the awning. We can admire it without asking it to become a new design.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: One covered lamp is enough for this seam tonight. Plink helped me choose where the shade should fall.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Wet night, dry spool. That seems a good arrangement. There is a dry place for you beside the worktable too.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Would you help choose a patch for this panel? Amber or violet. Either will show, and either will make a sound mend.

choices.text: I would like to help choose.
I will come back to the cloth later.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Thank you. Meet me at the silk awning, where we can see the cloth in a steady light.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Certainly. I shall keep both scraps. Cloth is quite good at waiting without taking it personally.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The panel is under the silk awning. Come look when you would like to choose its patch.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Here are the two scraps. We can choose the amber patch or the violet patch when we display the mend. Neither needs to disappear.

choices.text: I am ready to choose at the panel.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: A hidden repair and a visible repair can both be careful work. For this panel, I would like to stop pretending it never needed help.

choices.text: I am ready to choose at the panel.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: At the panel, choose either patch colour and help display the mended cloth. The choice will stay yours; both seams are ready to hold.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The display interaction beside the panel lets you choose the patch and hang the cloth. Amber or violet, both belong here.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: There it is, hanging with its patch in view. I can see what we changed, and I like the cloth better for knowing it.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Keep this small patch sample. I made the stitches easy to see. Thank you for helping me leave the repair in the story.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Someone admired the patch before the rest of the panel. I discovered that I did not mind.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: I put the remaining scraps in the useful box. It used to be called the almost box. A small change, but a pleasant one.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: You can ask about the cloth, or bring something else to talk about. I have more interests than this spool suggests.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: You let the patch be a choice instead of a mistake to hide. I feel I can show a friend a piece before I have finished fixing it.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Next time I may bring you the awkward first attempt. I usually hide those beneath the tidiest one.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: I have left a clear corner of the table. For company, not another job that needs doing.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: At the gathering, the mended panel belonged with all the other cloth. You helped me see that being cared for can be part of its beauty.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: When I miss the highland mornings, I do not need to fold the feeling away. I think I could tell you while we worked.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: You have seen the loose ends and stayed. It makes an unfinished afternoon feel rather comfortable.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: We have cloth for the gathering. What we need now is a notice everyone can answer, not a brighter lamp.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The shared plan leaves room for a ground display as well as a calm-weather view. I have sewn the panel to look lovely at basket height.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The sheltered display will keep the cloth dry. The rain can be part of the view, without being part of the seating.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The repaired panel caught the same warm light as every other one. I did not spend the evening checking whether anyone noticed its patch.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Puffrel has suggested another ribbon. I have suggested leaving room to see the basket. We are making progress.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Plink chose the softer side of the lamp. A useful reminder that light can help without doing quite so much.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: This thread has one stubborn loop. We shall work around it. Neither of us needs a dramatic afternoon.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The notice is sound, but the reply is missing from this copy. Help me test a steady signal at the awning?

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Try Glow, or use the covered lantern by hand. Either will do. We need one readable light, not a flashing code.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: I'll keep both versions together. A quiet reply is still a reply.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Test the steady signal at the silk awning. If you would rather save your magic, use the covered lantern.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Clear enough to read from the next terrace. Here is the missing reply: visits can arrive a little at a time.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Like the patch we left visible, this reply belongs beside the first message. The steady light makes it easy to find.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The first notice asked for one shared ascent. This copy kept traveling after the plan changed. No one had the whole conversation.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: Ombel is in Lamploom. Show the town both messages, so the welcome can fit the water and the people.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The patch did not need to be invisible. Neither did the change of plan.

choices.text: Will everyone understand the new signal?

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: The light only says there is a message. The words travel too, on a copied card. Nobody has to guess at a flicker.

nodes.speaker: selvie
nodes.text: I'll fold the old notice beside the reply, not over it.
